mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meal_conversation (session_id, meal_time, taste) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{mealTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{taste,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE meal_conversation SET meal_time = COALESCE(#{mealTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, meal_time), taste = COALESCE(#{taste,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, taste) WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
